_meta.status: PILOT v4 - D-032. Not registered in CLAIMS.md, not on the site.
rules: Ad account spends in US dollars (tested by CPM: naira accounts show CPMs of 500+)
The study's per-group report reconciles with Meta's reported spend, so group costs add up to the total
At least $500 of advertising and at least 200 qualified respondents
Recruitment waves only: baseline or single-wave studies. Follow-up waves re-contact people and are excluded
Studies that fed one survey at the same time are combined: spend summed, respondents counted once
The targeting can be stated in a sentence, and it did what it said

definitions.qualified_respondent: a person counted toward one of the study's quota groups: they are in the targeted group and completed the screening (the study's own quota rule, e.g. answered through to the phone-number question). Taken from the study's latest optimisation report (FACEBOOK_ADOPT current_participants).
definitions.ad_cost: Meta-reported advertising spend (per-group lifetime_spent, which reconciles with Insights) / qualified respondents. Excludes incentives, the survey platform and our fee.

terms.radius_area: a pin Meta lets an advertiser drop on the map, with a radius of 1-80 km (Marketing API custom_locations). 'Inside the radius areas' and 'outside them' are the two sides of that line. Never 'circles' (too plain, per Nandan) and never urban/rural (official definitions vary; the targeting rarely matches them)
terms.qualified_respondent: someone in one of the study's quota groups who completed the screening questions
terms.whole_division: ads shown to people Meta places anywhere inside the division (a Meta region). Meta offers seven Bangladeshi divisions; Mymensingh, created from Dhaka in 2015, is not one of them

_meta.queries: scripts/data/country-queries.sql; spend.sql in this directory (per-campaign spend, CPM, ad days)

all_people_surveyed.note: Distinct user_id in inference_data across every Bangladesh study on the current platform, tests and endlines included. Anyone who answered in any of them.

study.incentive_note: none in the study configuration (no incentive_per_respondent; no payment field in the form)
study.quota_rule: in a quota group and answered the 'seen HPV vaccine ads in the last 3 months' question, question 48 of 52. The form screens out anyone who does not consent, does not care for a girl, or cares for a girl under 9 or over 17, in the first seven questions
study.quotas: Division (7, whole Meta regions) × two ad sets (women's and men's creatives, NOT gender-targeted): 14 equal groups

by_gender_adset_not_for_publication.note: The two 'Gender' ad sets were not restricted by gender on Meta (no genders key; the Gender variable's facebook_targeting is empty). Self-reported gender among qualified: 'Men' ad sets 629 women / 843 men; 'Women' ad sets 689 women / 761 men. So these are creative versions, not genders. Do not publish.

checks: per-group lifetime_spent sums to $5,909.92, exactly Meta's reported spend for the one campaign
ad account 272226257305969 (all 18 Bangladesh studies): CPM $0.23–0.62, so US dollars, not taka
targeting saved 21 Nov 2023, before the first ad day (30 Nov); the 11 Dec re-save is identical
1,000 respondents from the 8–12 Nov test run share this study's inference data under different labels ('All Age', 'Rangpour'); none match a stratum id, so none are counted as qualified
24,624 people started from the study's ads; 2,878 qualified (11.7%)

hpv_baseline_2024.design: one survey (BDTBaselineBangla), four concurrent ad runs, one per trial arm; each run targets its own set of 1 km radius areas (about 980 pins in total) in Chittagong, Barisal and Sylhet
why_held: the candidate figure '$797, 1,101 qualified' for -t2 alone is double-counted: all four arms' reports carry the same 1,101 qualified (the survey-wide pool); combined it is $1,296 for 1,101
radius areas only, no 'outside' side, so no within-study place comparison
Meta places 2 of the pins in India (country 'IN'); the pins were not otherwise checked
set against 2023 it invites a cross-year comparison that cannot be explained: the 2024 survey is shorter (qualifying question 33 of 36, not 48 of 52) and used a different campaign objective

follow_up_waves: remaining-divisions-bangladesh-hpv-endline (13–22 Dec 2024, $807.64, 3,366 qualified, $0.24; whole Dhaka, Khulna, Rajshahi, Rangpur). NOTE: a fresh ad-recruited cross-section, not a re-contact: only 564 of its 10,110 people were in an earlier Bangladesh study. Passes every other mechanical rule
t1-, t2-, t3-, t4-bangladesh-hpv-endline (13–22 Dec 2024, $378, $448, $579, $308; 1 km radius areas)
under_7_ad_days: bangladesh-baseline-remaining-divisions (3 days, $307; 1,007 qualified, whole Khulna, Rajshahi, Rangpur)
under_500_or_200: bangladesh-hpv-baseline-t1/-t4 alone ($345, $13): combined with siblings, see held_for_review
shared_campaign: bangladesh-baseline-test and -test-2 share campaign 'Bangla HPV Baseline TEST'
umbrella_double_count: the four 2024 baseline arms each report the same 1,101 qualified (see held_for_review)

strata_note: Stratum ids are the study's own labels ('Khula' = Khulna). Meta region names are used on the page: Barisal and Chittagong, officially Barishal and Chattogram since 2018.
